en-US.whatsNew:
YOL 1.3.2
• New languages: Italian and Indonesian
• Fixed an issue that kept the fight screen from opening in Coach, Referee and Manager modes
• Stability improvements

New in 1.3.0: the Youth Path, Boxing, Muay Thai, Grappling and Wrestling leagues, WATCH TACTICS, daily goals and redrawn fighters.
en-US.promotionalText: New: the Youth Path and 4 combat sports leagues! Start as a kid, win belts in boxing, Muay Thai, grappling and wrestling, and run fights with WATCH TACTICS.
